issue.title: test_sudo_runner_invocation_keeps_canary_out_of_process_argv_and_env flakes under full just check
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1g4.1.1.4 note #5 during surface verification of epic sase-1g4.1.1.

just check ToolRun 5f4761a962676903e627a36a4d0b5365 failed this node under the 14-worker lane with AssertionError: credential length leaked into process metadata (canary length 8119 in /proc environ). Isolation pytest of the same node passed (0.34s call). Fail rate was not measured beyond that one full-lane failure and one isolation pass. The surface diff does not touch sudo.

Ready sibling sase-19d is a different node in the same file (test_sudo_local_flow_never_persists_canary_credentials). Do not +1 retired umbrella sase-ct. sase-j7 note #86 already records this observation; it is not a confirmed process-global leak, so this stays node-specific.
